messages:
Maya: FYI — final preflight for ACME's migration tomorrow. Putting a short checklist for CS + SEs. TL;DR: warmup + small prefetch, enable streaming for chat flows, set short-term quota, watch compute err rate.
Samir: love it. can you paste the curl we should run for warmup? :rocket:
Maya: sure — run 10 parallel requests hitting the new model endpoint with streaming disabled then enable streaming after warmup.
Maya: ```bash
for i in {1..10}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b", "input":"Hello world", "stream":false}' &
done
wait
```
Henry_CS: add this 30s sleep between batches if you see GPU queueing spikes. keeps the scheduler from thrashing.
Samir: for prefetch suggestion — run prefix cache seed for top 50 prompts. example payload we used for ACME POC: 
Samir: ```json
{"prefixes": ["order status", "refund policy", "account balance"], "concurrency": 5}
```
Kate_Eng: engineering note — enable KV cache and set batching window=20ms for low-latency interactive flows. If they need throughput, bump window to 50-100ms; monitor token throughput and avg latency.
Maya: renewal risk flag: ACME has heavy weekday traffic spikes. If latency > 250ms p95 for >1 hour during trial, escalate to enterprise onboarding and propose reserved capacity.
acme_csm: Sending config and warmup plan to ACME ops now. They want streaming enabled only for chat flows, not bulk inference.
Samir: for streaming, use the SSE endpoint pattern: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer?stream=true and ensure the client processes delta tokens. quick example: ```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"Summarize this...","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer
```
deploy-bot: deploy completed: acme/env/prod -> model redwood-7b @ 1728245690 :white_check_mark:
Maya: next steps: (1) SE run warmup script 30m before handover (2) CS monitor p95 and error-rate for first 2 hours (3) schedule 30-min post-mortem if any regression. I put the checklist in the customer onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/cs/acme-handoff
Henry_CS: noted. I'll be on the handoff call at 11:00 PT. :calendar:
Maya: thanks all, keep thread updated with any anomalies. :thumbsup:
